title: 封闭温室怎么建（国内版）

points.K3: 管理制度和手册一起建
points.K14: 流程二：初步设计查合规
points.K15: 流程三：施工中及时沟通
points.K17: 工程设施比温室大得多
points.K24: 穿墙灭菌器：出去必灭菌
points.S1: 熏蒸消毒：清场通风再进
points.S4: 改动布局，先评估再动工

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一座玻璃温室和一栋设备楼之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a glass greenhouse and a large plant-equipment building.
shots.narration: 这一课，讲转基因封闭温室怎么建。

shots.scene: 一张设施蓝图慢慢展开
shots.prompt_en: A facility blueprint slowly unrolls on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 从选址、流程，到布局和设备。

shots.scene: 老周在会议桌旁宣布要建新温室，阿杰举手
shots.prompt_en: The older man announces a new greenhouse project at a meeting table; the young male student raises his hand.
shots.narration: 老周说，课题组要建转基因温室。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着田边一块空地和一套现成温室图片
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at an empty plot next to a crop field and a picture of a ready-made greenhouse.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：买个现成的，放田边就行。

shots.scene: 老李和小研摇头，拿出空白设计清单
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the female graduate student shake their heads and hold up a blank design checklist.
shots.narration: 老李摇头：封闭设施，要专门设计。

shots.scene: 一摞钱币图标压在设施蓝图上
shots.prompt_en: A stack of coin icons resting on a facility blueprint. No people.
shots.narration: 建封闭设施投入很大，

shots.scene: 老周看着预算表皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The older man frowns at a blank budget sheet.
shots.narration: 动笔之前，先把钱算清楚。

shots.scene: 地图上设施紧挨农田，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A map icon with a facility right next to farm fields, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 设施别紧挨着农田。

shots.scene: 花粉飘向农田，旁边出现法槌图标
shots.prompt_en: Pollen drifting toward farm fields, with a judge's gavel icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 万一泄漏，还会惹上法律纠纷。

shots.section_title: 管理制度和手册一起建
shots.scene: 组织结构图：负责人、几名管理人员、设施经理
shots.prompt_en: An org chart icon: a lead, several staff figures, and a facility manager badge. No people.
shots.narration: 先定谁负责、配几人、要不要经理。
overlay: 管理制度和手册一起建

shots.section_title: 管理制度和手册一起建
shots.scene: 一辆卡通汽车旁放着一本说明书
shots.prompt_en: A cartoon car with an owner's manual beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 像买车要配说明书，

shots.section_title: 管理制度和手册一起建
shots.scene: 设施模型旁放着一本封面空白的手册
shots.prompt_en: A facility model with a blank-covered biosafety manual beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 楼建好，生物安全手册也要同时建好。

shots.scene: 房间剖面图，箭头向内表示负压
shots.prompt_en: A room cutaway with arrows pointing inward to show negative pressure. No people.
shots.narration: 负压设施，空气要稳定地往里流。

shots.scene: 墙体、玻璃、密封条三个图标加粗
shots.prompt_en: Three icons outlined in bold: a wall, a glass panel, and a door seal. No people.
shots.narration: 墙、玻璃、密封都要够结实。

shots.scene: 风机故障图标，玻璃出现裂纹
shots.prompt_en: A broken fan icon and a glass panel showing a crack. No people.
shots.narration: 风机出故障，负压过大会撑破玻璃。

shots.scene: 温室里灯光和水雾图标
shots.prompt_en: Inside a greenhouse, light rays and mist icons over plants. No people.
shots.narration: 植物离不开光照和湿度。

shots.scene: 生锈的金属件被打叉，旁边耐腐蚀材料打勾
shots.prompt_en: A rusty metal part crossed out, a corrosion-resistant panel with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 换批时要熏蒸，材料得耐湿耐腐蚀。

shots.scene: 阳光照进温室，温度计升高，空调账单变长
shots.prompt_en: Sunlight pours into a greenhouse, a thermometer rises, an air-conditioner bill gets longer. No people.
shots.narration: 阳光进来，热量也进来，制冷更贵。

shots.scene: 炎热地区：封闭房间加人工灯和空调
shots.prompt_en: A hot-climate icon beside a closed room with artificial lights and an air conditioner. No people.
shots.narration: 炎热地区，宜用封闭房间加人工光。

shots.scene: 凉爽地区：玻璃温室打勾
shots.prompt_en: A cool-climate icon beside a glass greenhouse with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 凉爽地区，用温室更合适。

shots.scene: 一台电脑屏幕上显示温度、湿度图标
shots.prompt_en: A computer screen showing temperature and humidity icons with control sliders. No people.
shots.narration: 加热、制冷、湿度，

shots.scene: 老李在控制台前查看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks readings at a control console.
shots.narration: 都由电子系统集中控制和监测。

shots.scene: 带标志的废物袋进入高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A labelled biohazard waste bag goes into an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭设施出来的废物，

shots.scene: 灭菌后的袋子贴上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The treated bag comes out with a green check tag. No people.
shots.narration: 要先去污灭菌，再按规定处置。

shots.scene: 种子盒被锁进带锁柜，门禁亮绿灯
shots.prompt_en: A seed box locked inside a cabinet, with an access-control light turning green. No people.
shots.narration: 还要有物理安保，

shots.scene: 一只手偷拿种子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand icon taking seeds out the door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 防止材料被盗、被私自扩繁。

shots.scene: 设施排水管直通市政下水道，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A facility drain pipe leading straight to a public sewer, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 设施的污水，不能直接进市政管网。

shots.scene: 排水管转入一个独立的废水处理罐
shots.prompt_en: The drain pipe instead goes into a separate wastewater treatment tank. No people.
shots.narration: 要另设管道，或专门处理后再排。

shots.scene: 一本法规书和一本指南并排
shots.prompt_en: A law book and a guideline booklet side by side, blank covers. No people.
shots.narration: 还要符合生物安全法规和指南。

shots.scene: 老李、小研、王老师围坐看图纸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, the female graduate student and the safety administrator sit around a blueprint.
shots.narration: 工程师懂结构，研究者懂生物，

shots.scene: 王老师把两边的图纸拼到一起
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator joins two halves of a blueprint together.
shots.narration: 管理者居中协调，两边都满足。

shots.scene: 七个图标排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Seven icons in a column. No people.
shots.narration: 设计要考虑七件事：

shots.scene: 钱币和扳手两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: coins for building cost and a wrench for running cost. No people.
shots.narration: 还有建造成本和运行成本。

shots.scene: 四个箭头框组成的流程，第一框亮起
shots.prompt_en: A four-box arrow flow chart with the first box highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 设计流程第一步：需求和预算。

shots.scene: 设施模型旁一个每年循环的维护扳手
shots.prompt_en: A facility model with a wrench icon on a yearly cycle arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 预算有限别贪大，每年都有维护费。

shots.section_title: 流程二：初步设计查合规
shots.scene: 流程第二框亮起，蓝图上盖章
shots.prompt_en: The second box lights up; a blueprint receives a review stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步：初步设计，查合不合规。
overlay: 流程二：初步设计查合规

shots.section_title: 流程二：初步设计查合规
shots.scene: 安全出口标志和建筑规范书
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign next to a building-code book. No people.
shots.narration: 建筑规范、消防出口，都要达标。

shots.section_title: 流程三：施工中及时沟通
shots.scene: 施工中加了一根梁，气流箭头变乱
shots.prompt_en: During construction a new beam is added and the airflow arrows become tangled. No people.
shots.narration: 施工中加根梁、隔个间，气流就变了。
overlay: 流程三：施工中及时沟通

shots.section_title: 流程三：施工中及时沟通
shots.scene: 小研把变化告诉老李
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tells the facility engineer about a change on the blueprint.
shots.narration: 设施是定制的，变了要马上告诉工程师。

shots.section_title: 流程三：施工中及时沟通
shots.scene: 关键节点上，用户在场确认
shots.prompt_en: At each milestone flag, the female graduate student checks the build with a checklist.
shots.narration: 使用者要在关键阶段参与。

shots.scene: 流程第四框亮起，认证证书图标
shots.prompt_en: The fourth box lights up with a certificate icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四步：经主管部门认证。

shots.scene: 没有证书的门上挂着停用牌
shots.prompt_en: A facility door with no certificate and a stop sign hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 没认证，就不能开展实验。

shots.section_title: 工程设施比温室大得多
shots.scene: 一座小温室旁一栋大得多的设备楼
shots.prompt_en: A small greenhouse beside a much larger equipment building. No people.
shots.narration: 温室占地并不大，
overlay: 工程设施比温室大得多

shots.section_title: 工程设施比温室大得多
shots.scene: 设备楼剖开：空调、过滤器、水处理罐
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the equipment building: air handlers, filters, and water treatment tanks. No people.
shots.narration: 空调、过滤、废水处理却占两三倍。

shots.scene: 住宅平面图，卫生间集中在一个管井旁
shots.prompt_en: A house floor plan with all bathrooms clustered around one plumbing shaft. No people.
shots.narration: 像住宅把卫生间集中在一处，

shots.scene: 管道变短，漏点被圈在小范围
shots.prompt_en: Shorter pipes, and a leak contained in a small area. No people.
shots.narration: 管道省，漏了也不会到处蔓延。

shots.scene: 几间实验室并排共用一套风管
shots.prompt_en: Several lab rooms side by side sharing one duct system. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室相邻布置，通风系统才经济。

shots.scene: 水槽下水管连到去污罐
shots.prompt_en: A sink drain connected to a decontamination tank. No people.
shots.narration: 从设施出去的一切都要去污，

shots.scene: 流出的水滴上病原和DNA图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Water drops leaving the tank with microbe and DNA icons crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 连水槽流下的废水也不例外。

shots.scene: 布局示意图，五个图标依次出现
shots.prompt_en: A layout diagram with five icons appearing one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 标准布局有五条原则：

shots.scene: 从清洁到污染由浅到深的色带
shots.prompt_en: A colour band shading from clean to contaminated across the floor plan. No people.
shots.narration: 区域按清洁到污染分级，人和物按路线走。

shots.scene: 阿杰把一盒种子放进暂存区架子
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a box of seeds on a shelf in a staging room.
shots.narration: 材料先送进暂存区，

shots.scene: 种子盒沿箭头转入温室
shots.prompt_en: The seed box moves along an arrow into the greenhouse. No people.
shots.narration: 再按程序转入温室。

shots.scene: 控制室里多块屏幕：监控、气流、门锁图标
shots.prompt_en: A control room with several screens showing camera, airflow and door-lock icons. No people.
shots.narration: 监控、气流、门锁，

shots.scene: 老李在控制台集中操作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer operates everything from one control console.
shots.narration: 都在控制区一处集中管理。

shots.scene: 缓冲间两道门，外门开、内门关
shots.prompt_en: An airlock with two doors: the outer door open, the inner door closed. No people.
shots.narration: 出入口是缓冲间，有两道门。

shots.scene: 小研进入后关外门，再开内门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student steps in, closes the outer door, then opens the inner door.
shots.narration: 先关外门，再开内门，不能同时开。

shots.scene: 内门打开时，气流箭头向内
shots.prompt_en: As the inner door opens, airflow arrows point inward. No people.
shots.narration: 开内门时，空气往里流，不往外跑。

shots.section_title: 穿墙灭菌器：出去必灭菌
shots.scene: 墙上嵌着一台双门高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A double-door autoclave built into a wall between two rooms. No people.
shots.narration: 灭菌器嵌在墙里，两边开门。
overlay: 穿墙灭菌器：出去必灭菌

shots.section_title: 穿墙灭菌器：出去必灭菌
shots.scene: 进来的箭头标无菌，出去的箭头标去污
shots.prompt_en: An inward arrow tagged sterile and an outward arrow tagged decontaminated. No people.
shots.narration: 进来要干净，出去更要去污。

shots.section_title: 穿墙灭菌器：出去必灭菌
shots.scene: 植株、土壤、种子、连体服排队进灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A plant, a soil bag, a seed packet and reusable coveralls line up to enter the autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 植株、土壤、种子、工作服，

shots.section_title: 穿墙灭菌器：出去必灭菌
shots.scene: 欣欣指着灭菌器出口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the autoclave's clean-side door.
shots.narration: 全都灭菌后才出去，这是法律要求。

shots.scene: 培养基瓶和土壤袋进入蒸汽灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Media bottles and soil bags go into a steam sterilizer. No people.
shots.narration: 进设施的培养基、土壤，先蒸汽灭菌。

shots.scene: 土壤和水里的病原图标被消灭
shots.prompt_en: Microbe icons in soil and water disappear. No people.
shots.narration: 去掉土壤和水里带的病原。

shots.scene: 项目结束，未获批准的植株进入销毁袋
shots.prompt_en: At project end, unapproved plants are placed into a destruction bag. No people.
shots.narration: 项目结束，未批准放行的植株按规程销毁。

shots.scene: 遗传操作室里一台空白外壳的转化设备
shots.prompt_en: A genetic manipulation room with a blank-panelled transformation instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 遗传操作区放转化设备，

shots.scene: 转化后的小苗沿箭头送进封闭生长室
shots.prompt_en: Transformed seedlings move along an arrow into a contained growth room. No people.
shots.narration: 转化后的苗，再送进封闭设施培养。

shots.scene: 一排独立的生长室，每间有温湿度图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of separate growth rooms, each with its own temperature and humidity icon. No people.
shots.narration: 植物生长室各自独立，

shots.scene: 生长室负压，花粉被留在室内
shots.prompt_en: Inward arrows on a growth room door keep pollen dots inside. No people.
shots.narration: 负压加监测，花粉跑不出去。

shots.scene: 空调、加湿器、灯光控制、灌溉管四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: central air conditioning, humidifier, lighting control, irrigation pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 辅助设备：空调、加湿、照明、灌溉。

shots.scene: 手撒肥料被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand scattering fertiliser, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 封闭设施里不撒施肥料，

shots.scene: 电脑控制的泵定时把肥水送进管道
shots.prompt_en: A computer-controlled pump sends fertiliser solution into pipes on a timer. No people.
shots.narration: 由电脑控制，水肥定时定量泵进去。

shots.scene: 实验室上方一层设备层，管道和过滤箱
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway: a lab with a service floor above holding ducts and filter boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤和送风设备都放在上方设备层。

shots.scene: 设备层里老李弯腰检修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer crouches in the service floor above the lab, checking a filter box.
shots.narration: 层高要够人进去检修。

shots.scene: 灯具在玻璃密封板上方，从上面更换
shots.prompt_en: A light fixture sits above a sealed glass panel and is replaced from above. No people.
shots.narration: 灯和过滤器都从上面换，房间不开口。

shots.section_title: 熏蒸消毒：清场通风再进
shots.scene: 温室门口挂着熏蒸中的警示牌，门锁着
shots.prompt_en: A greenhouse door locked with a fumigation-in-progress warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 熏蒸用的药剂对人也有害。
overlay: 熏蒸消毒：清场通风再进

shots.section_title: 熏蒸消毒：清场通风再进
shots.scene: 王老师清点人员，确认室内无人
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator counts people outside and confirms the room is empty.
shots.narration: 熏蒸前清场，专人操作，门口挂牌。

shots.section_title: 熏蒸消毒：清场通风再进
shots.scene: 通风图标转动，检测仪亮绿灯后开门
shots.prompt_en: A ventilation icon spins, a detector light turns green, then the door unlocks. No people.
shots.narration: 通风、检测合格后，才能进去。

shots.scene: 温室里温度计很高，阿杰满头汗
shots.prompt_en: Inside a hot greenhouse, a high thermometer; the young male student sweats heavily.
shots.narration: 温室和生长室又热又闷，

shots.scene: 水杯、休息椅、轮换时钟三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a water cup, a rest chair, and a rotation clock. No people.
shots.narration: 多喝水、轮换休息，别久待。

shots.scene: 阿杰头晕，小研扶他到外面阴凉处
shots.prompt_en: The young male student feels dizzy; the female graduate student helps him to a shaded area outside.
shots.narration: 头晕乏力，马上出来降温并报告。

shots.scene: 潮湿地面上的插线板被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A power strip lying on a wet floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 温室潮湿，插线板别放地上。

shots.scene: 防水插座和漏电保护开关图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a waterproof socket and a residual-current breaker. No people.
shots.narration: 用防水插座，装漏电保护。

shots.scene: 湿手碰开关被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A wet hand touching a switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 湿手不碰电器，故障找电工。

shots.section_title: 改动布局，先评估再动工
shots.scene: 阿杰想在生长室里加一道隔墙
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sketches an extra partition wall inside a growth room.
shots.narration: 建成后想改布局、加隔断，
overlay: 改动布局，先评估再动工

shots.section_title: 改动布局，先评估再动工
shots.scene: 空白申请单送到王老师和老李手里
shots.prompt_en: A blank change request form passes to the safety administrator and the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 先评估、经审批，不能自己动手。

shots.section_title: 改动布局，先评估再动工
shots.scene: 改造后风速仪检测，打勾
shots.prompt_en: After the change, an airflow meter test on the room gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 改完要重新检测，合格再用。

shots.scene: 一株作物和一条DNA双螺旋图标
shots.prompt_en: A crop plant beside a DNA double-helix icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物技术让育种有了新办法，

shots.scene: 转基因实验旁一本法规书和审批章
shots.prompt_en: A transgenic experiment icon beside a law book and an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因实验受法律管制。

shots.scene: 违规图标后接停止牌和法槌
shots.prompt_en: A violation icon followed by a stop sign and a gavel. No people.
shots.narration: 违规会被叫停，还要承担法律责任。

shots.scene: 评估、减缓、绩效三个相连圆圈
shots.prompt_en: Three connected circles rotating in a loop. No people.
shots.narration: 管理风险，靠评估、减缓、绩效。

shots.scene: 天平：可能性和后果
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale: a dice icon and a consequence warning icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险看可能性，也看后果。

shots.scene: 五层控制金字塔
shots.prompt_en: A five-band control pyramid. No people.
shots.narration: 按消除到防护，一层层加控制。

shots.scene: 风险条再测，不够就再加一层
shots.prompt_en: A risk bar re-measured; when still too long, another control layer is added. No people.
shots.narration: 加完再评估，不可接受就再加。

shots.scene: 高风险实验旁一摞钱币
shots.prompt_en: A high-risk experiment icon beside a tall stack of coins. No people.
shots.narration: 风险越高，投入的资金也要越足。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁：选址地图、四步流程、布局图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot beside three icons: a site map, a four-step flow, and a floor plan.
shots.narration: 选好址、走流程、认证后再用。

shots.scene: 缓冲间、穿墙灭菌器、负压生长室图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an airlock, a wall-mounted autoclave, and a negative-pressure growth room. No people.
shots.narration: 两道门、负压，出去的一律去污。

shots.scene: 熏蒸警示牌、水杯、防水插座、申请单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fumigation warning sign, a water cup, a waterproof socket, and a change request form. No people.
shots.narration: 熏蒸清场、防暑防电、改动先审批。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在建成的温室前竖大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs-up in front of a finished contained greenhouse.
shots.narration: 设计想周全，设施才安全好用。

shots.scene: 欣欣在温室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the greenhouse airlock door.
shots.narration: 封闭温室这样建，我们下次见！
